why: Chase, Hunter and Tao (arXiv, Jul 2026) prove the Cramer random-model analogue of Gilbreath's conjecture and give a deterministic inverse theorem isolating the specific obstructions to the real conjecture (long blocks of zeroes or shallow blocks); the conjecture itself remains open but this is structural progress on the actual problem, distinct from mere computational verification.
